title: Vendor script compromise
summary: A third-party script on a page the operator runs no longer matches the approved hash, or a new script appeared beside a session.
lesson: L7 third-party browser scripts are supply chain
breaks_link: actions on objectives, by cancel-only and a session refresh; delivery, by a CSP denial of the vendor origin at the operator's own edge

steps.text: Confirm on a second channel that this freeze was requested by a human you already trust. Sentinel did not place this call.
steps.lesson: L9 freezes thaw and are verified out of band

steps.text: Read the finding. Name the page, the vendor, and the script URL. Do not paste script bodies into chat.
steps.lesson: L7 third-party browser scripts are supply chain

steps.text: On your own trading or session system, switch to the pre-approved cancel-only or read-only mode. Sentinel cannot flip this switch.
steps.lesson: L9 freezes thaw and are verified out of band

steps.text: Pause your own relayer or embedded signer so open tabs cannot keep signing. A front-end deploy does not reach those tabs.
steps.lesson: L8 signing path is part of the key

steps.text: Revoke sessions and tokens so already-open tabs lose authority.
steps.lesson: L8 signing path is part of the key

steps.text: At your own edge, deny the vendor origin in CSP. This is your config change, made by your change process.
steps.lesson: L7 third-party browser scripts are supply chain

steps.text: Review the drafts. You send them. Sentinel does not.
Open a change card to remove the vendor tag, pin or self-host what you still need, and keep vendor script off session pages.
steps.lesson: L7 third-party browser scripts are supply chain

thaw: Envelope expiry has passed, or the commander ends it early in writing.
Vendor origin is still denied until a new hash is approved.
Sessions that overlapped the bad hash were revoked.
A root-cause card exists. It cites the lesson id and the ledger seq.
Out-of-band confirm that thaw was requested by the commander.
